notes:
Item Spawn is now more stable across goals, respawns, matches, and returns to the main menu. Connection handoffs retry automatically, spawned loadouts and goal explosions are retained more reliably, and older Rocket League socket responses are supported.

BondoSpawner now includes Item Spawn and Title Spawn with updated item, swapper, and title catalogs. Title Swapper no longer depends on a missing local title database, and Name Changer supports punctuation such as . and !.

Some cosmetics may still have visual bugs. Please report any issue immediately so it can be fixed.
